# std/neg

> - : negation

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/neg.pkg) · translated by [bintables/neg](../bintables/neg.md)

`-x` negates an integer.

```
print -(2 + 3)  // -5
```

Prefix, precedence 70 (binds tighter than every infix operator). The
operand must be `int`.

## Syntax

Kind: `prefix`, precedence 70, left-associative

```
- {operand: expr int} -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `operand` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`
